title: Chapter 92
text:
"I need to use your military transport aircraft."

Han Xiao spoke to Antonio in the Fabian Company's base.

Antonio was slightly shocked. "We only use the military transport aircraft for large transactions. Even if you are a Black Gold VIP, you still have to pay the corresponding fees."

"I know."

"Alright. How many people do you want to transport and when do you leave?"

"Just me. Immediately."

Antonio's chubby face trembled. He was speechless for a long time before he finally said, "What a waste."

The military transport aircraft would take about a day to reach the destination. The aircraft was equipped with a simple workshop. Han Xiao could also use the machines on the military transport aircraft to gain experience. He did not have to waste time on the journey.

"Are you sure the fee is 50,000 yuan per trip?"

Han Xiao took out a stack of cash from his briefcase and threw it on the table. "When do you board the plane?"

"In an hour."

Fabian Company had rented a long-term take-off runway at Chenfeng City's airport. A few large dark green transport aircraft were parked at the platform. Han Xiao brought the equipment and materials onto one of the aircraft. Soon, he could feel the structure of the aircraft vibrating. The aircraft began to accelerate and soar into the sky.

Once the stratosphere stabilized, he could start to build the machines.

…

The scorching sun shone on the boundless desert. The yellow sand was heated to the point where it was unbearable for the human body.

More than twenty people staggered as they trudged through the desert.

They were wearing tattered gray robes that had not been washed for a long time. They were emitting a foul smell. Sweat had soaked their clothes and made them stick to their bodies. Their lips were dry and cracked, their eye sockets were sunken, and their faces were full of fatigue. They were swaying as if they were going to fall at any time. The horses they were leading were also thin and sickly.

There used to be an oasis country in the Somar Desert. They lived a prosperous and healthy life. After the war broke out, the country was destroyed. The oasis was destroyed by guns and cannons and assimilated with the surrounding desert. This group of people in ragged clothes was once the people of this country.

There was a legend in the Old Kingdom. It was said that in the depths of the Somar Desert, there were relics of another civilization from millions of years ago. They preserved a treasure that could control the desert! During the war decades ago, there was an abnormal change in the Somar Desert. The sand was like an ocean current, forming a huge whirlpool that swept across the desert. It swam continuously, as if it was controlled by someone. After seven days, it automatically disappeared. The evidence and documents disappeared with the destruction of the oasis country. Some of the survivors of the old country firmly believed in this legend and wanted to obtain this legendary treasure. They pinned their hopes of reviving their country on the legend and had been searching for it for many years.

Pilgrims, this was the nickname given by the wanderers near the Somar Desert to the remnants of the old country.

These twenty or so people were the last pilgrims.

"The Felonia Ruins, the power of magic, it definitely exists …" the oldest pilgrim mumbled to himself.

…

In the Somar Desert, a convoy returned to the heavily guarded fortress.

"Dorothy, is there still no harvest this time?" Rose Militant's leader, Luo Qing, asked with a cold expression.

"This time, the search area is E4, E5, and D4. There is still no trace of Felonia," Dorothy replied in a muffled voice.

Dorothy answered in a muffled voice. She was a strong black woman, and a centipede-like scar made her face look horrible. Her arms, which were exposed outside of her tactical vest, were strong and muscular. There were tattoos on them, but they were covered by her skin color. If one did not look closely, one would not be able to see them. No one would know the meaning of the tattoos.

Rose Militant was an armed mercenary organization. All of them were women. Their base was located in the depths of the Somar Desert, and they searched for Felonia all year round.

Rose Militant had two instructors. The other instructor, Ghostly Fox, was a slender white woman. She was an expert assassin.

"During this search, we exchanged fire with Gaton's people. Wenli and Ceci are dead."

Almost all of the returning female mercenaries were injured. There were many bullet holes in their bulletproof vests, and the ceramic lining inside was shattered.

Luo Qing's eyes turned cold. "Be careful in the next search. The Rothschild family, the sponsor of Gaton's group, has been trying to get rid of us."

Every armed group in the Somar Desert had their own sponsors. They were stationed in the desert in order to find Felonia. There would be a small battle every three days and a big battle every five days. The mercenaries who could survive in the desert had at least ten lives on their hands. They were all ruthless people who lived on the edge of their blades.

…

Han Xiao felt the plane shake, and a strong force pressed him against his seat. After a while, it finally stopped.

"We have landed." The pilot's voice came from the broadcast.

Han Xiao carried his luggage and walked out of the plane. The hot and humid air hit his face.

The landing site was a medium-sized warehouse surrounded by barbed wire. Many armed men were patrolling the area. This was the base of Fabian Group in the Somar Desert. Fabian Group was a global arms company, so they had bases in every region to facilitate logistics. After all, the express delivery companies here did not send weapons.

"Welcome to the Somar Desert." Antonio also walked out of the plane. His fat body stretched his white shirt, and the outline of his body could be seen clearly. It was no different from a topless man.

"Why did you follow me here?"

"Haha, the person in charge of the Somar Desert was involved in a fight some time ago. That unlucky guy's skull was blown off by a stray bullet. So, I came here to arrange some matters. Coincidentally, I haven't been traveling for a while."

Han Xiao nodded and did not hesitate. "I need information on the distribution of forces in the Somar Desert and a map of the coordinates. I also need to borrow a desert off-road vehicle."

"I will get someone to arrange it for you."

The Somar Desert was huge. It would take a person ten days to drive an off-road vehicle across the desert without any rest or deviation. Because of the desert environment, it was difficult to determine one's direction. Thus, only radar could be used as a map. Many armed groups were stationed in the Somar Desert.

Han Xiao did not understand why people gathered in this barren land to fight for their lives.

"To find Felonia."

"What is that?" Han Xiao was curious. He had no impression of this name. It was obviously a hidden mission that no one had triggered in his previous life.

Antonio laughed and said, "I don't know either."

Han Xiao could see that Antonio was evading the question. He raised his eyebrows and did not say anything. He picked up his equipment and got into the vehicle. He was going to investigate the base of Rose Militant.

"I wish you all the best." Antonio waved his hand lazily.

The barbed wire gate opened, and Han Xiao drove the off-road vehicle out.

…

With the help of the radar, Han Xiao arrived at the base of the Rose Militant within a few hours. He observed the base through a telescope.

The base of Rose Militant was a small fortress with tight security. It had a concrete outer wall and barbed wire. There was only one entrance and exit.

There were sentry towers built inside, and there were always lookouts watching the surroundings. The view was excellent, and there was also a high-powered searchlight that would be turned on at night.

Han Xiao concluded that it was impossible to sneak in unless one could escape into the sand.

Moreover, Rose Militant was a group of women with big breasts and perky buttocks. His buttocks were perky, but he could not squeeze out his breasts. Even with the Face Simulator, he could not hide it.

The infiltration plan was GG.

Han Xiao looked at the numerous howitzers and dozens of heavy machine guns on the sentry tower. He also looked at the sturdy concrete outer wall.

Well, the direct attack plan was also GG.

"I can only lure the snake out of its hole. I have to use traps and create something new." Han Xiao retreated quietly.

He returned to Fabian's base and borrowed Antonio's workshop.

He still had seven potential points. He raised [Basic Electromagnetic Theory] to Level 4 and [Basic Wide Area Sensing] to Level 3. He spent a total of four potential points.
